scene: You reach the windy observation deck high above the neon-lit cityscape.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide observation deck under the night sky. On the far left, a brass telescope points outward. In the centre sits a wooden counter with a silver bell. The pink-tracksuit grandmother stands right-of-centre with her white dog, while a suspended wicker basket hangs waiting on the far right.
shown: a coin-operated brass telescope on a tripod at the far left railing
a gleaming silver desk bell on a round wooden counter in the centre
an open woven basket hooked to a slack zipline on the far right
